capabilities._comment: silero_vad is a voice-activity detector, not a speech recognizer. It produces per-chunk binary speech probabilities in [0, 1]. Supports streaming chunk-based inference (512-sample chunks with 64-sample reflect-pad context). No language, tokenizer, translation, timestamp, or diarization support.
